mapper.sql: m.menu_id, m.menu_name, m.parent_id, m.order_num, m.path, m.component, m.is_frame, m.menu_type, m.visible, m.status, m.perms, m.icon, m.create_by, m.create_time, m.update_by, m.update_time, m.remark
mapper.select: select distinct m.perms from sys_menu m inner join sys_role_menu rm on rm.menu_id = m.menu_id inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = rm.role_id inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and m.del_flag = 0 and m.status = 0 and r.del_flag = 0 and r.status = 0 and m.perms is not null and m.perms != ''

select distinct
from sys_menu m inner join sys_role_menu rm on rm.menu_id = m.menu_id inner join sys_user_role ur on ur.role_id = rm.role_id inner join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} and m.menu_type in ('M', 'C') and m.visible = 0 and m.status = 0 and m.del_flag = 0 and r.del_flag = 0 and r.status = 0 order by m.parent_id, m.order_num
select rm.menu_id from sys_role_menu rm inner join sys_menu m on m.menu_id = rm.menu_id where rm.role_id = #{roleId} and m.del_flag = 0 order by rm.menu_id
